headline: Italian waste workers recover €1m lottery ticket from rubbish
meta_description: An anonymous lottery player in southern Italy nearly lost a €1m winning ticket after mistakenly throwing it away. Waste workers found it after a two-day search.
summary_short: A lottery player in Bitonto, Italy accidentally binned a €1m winning ticket after being told it was non-payable. Refuse workers found it after searching through collecte…
body:
An anonymous lottery player in Bitonto, southern Italy came extraordinarily close to losing a €1 million prize after accidentally discarding his winning ticket in a shop bin. The man had checked his numbers and been told the ticket was "non-payable"—a message that appears when a prize exceeds what the retailer can pay out. Only when he returned home did his family notice that his favourite numbers—2, 4, 8, 10, and 51—had actually been drawn. Realising his mistake, the player contacted the refuse company, which immediately tracked down the bin lorry before its contents could be compacted and sent to landfill. What followed was a remarkable two-day search through what the company's director, Roberto Nicola Toscano, described as a "mountain of waste." The truck was escorted to a special site where waste workers sifted through the load until Tuesday morning, when the winning ticket was finally recovered. It was found in a hole-ridden bag alongside other damaged tickets, one of the few remaining intact.

The recovery operation required considerable effort and cost—a burden the player had agreed to bear by signing a declaration before the search began. Yet the story took an even lighter turn when Toscano and his colleagues, buoyed by the miracle they had just witnessed, bought a scratch card as a joke. They won €50. "This story is nothing short of miraculous," Toscano told Italian news agency Ansa, capturing the extraordinary luck that had transformed what could have been a crushing loss into a testament to persistence and teamwork.
quick_facts: €1 million winning ticket accidentally binned in Bitonto, southern Italy
Two-day search through refuse lorry waste on Sunday
Ticket found intact in hole-ridden bag with damaged tickets
Refuse company staff won €50 on scratch card after the recovery
